items.title: SBI, BoB, Canara Bank: 8 out of 12 Nifty PSU Bank stocks trade below 200-DMA
items.description: The 200-DMA is a technical indicator widely used to determine the long-term trends of the underlying index or stock. Indices or stocks trading below the 200-DMA are considered to be in a downtrend.

items.title: ₹1.1trn defence buys buoy stocks by 4%; HAL, BEL seen as top beneficiaries
items.description: The government has approved a proposal to purchase about ₹1.1 trillion worth of military materiel, with 98 per cent of procurements to be made from Indian companies.

items.title: Ray of Belief shares list at par with IPO price despite 108x subscription

items.title: Copper prices at record high send Hindustan Copper stock 4% higher
items.description: According to a Bloomberg report, copper prices rose for a fourth day on the London Metal Exchange (LME), touching an all-time peak of $14,617 a ton. The industrial metal is up 17 per cent this year.
